notes:
Pen haptic strength now matches between tablets.

**The haptic setting could show the wrong number.** Changing the pen's vibration strength wrote the new value correctly, but the app then asked the pen what it was set to before the pen had finished changing it — so the settings screen could show the previous value. Paired tablets appeared to disagree when they did not.

The app now gives the pen a moment before believing the answer, and asks again if it still disagrees.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
